'''Prit Kessek''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Clawdite/Legends|Clawdite]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Kessek was the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Transport/Legends|transport]] ''[[Skinchanger]]'' and she worked for the [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]] [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]] as a courier. At some point, Kessek was sent to [[Bazarre]], a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in the [[Mosu system]], to pick up some [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] that were to be taken to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zygerria/Legends|Zygerria]] on the behalf of the shipping magnate [[Brevis Taug]]. However, Kessek was attacked on the station by a group of agents who were investigating the transfer of Taug's funds, and the agents seized control of the ''Skinchanger'' from her.
